DML.SELECT: SELECT management_area_id as "id", element_type_id as "elementTypeId", element_id as "elementId", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.management_area_elements WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.management_area_elements (management_area_id, element_type_id, element_id, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:id, :elementTypeId, :elementId, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.management_area_elements WHERE management_area_id = :id AND element_type_id= :elementTypeId AND element_id= :elementId
